summary.zh: 定价页的套餐切换：免费 / 高级。选到高级时，“高级”字样升到上方，下面出现一道细括号把两个子选项（个人 / 团队）框在一起；子选项从挤在一起的小字长成正常大小，指示块从一条细线展开成药丸。纯 CSS。
summary.en: A pricing toggle: Free / Premium. Choose Premium and its label rises above the control with a thin bracket grouping the two sub-options (Solo / Team), which grow from tiny squeezed text to full size while the indicator unfolds from a thin line into a pill. Pure CSS.

technique.zh: 原作的思路：三个 radio + :has()。.premium:has(:checked) 一条规则同时改“高级”的位移缩放、子选项的 scale、内层指示块的 clip-path（从 inset 一条线到整颗药丸）。缓动是一条手写的 linear()。 AniMuse 版把外层指示块在高级档时换成浅灰轨道、选中的子档用实心黑药丸，并加了一道括号，层级更清楚。
technique.en: Jhey’s approach: three radios plus :has(). One .premium:has(:checked) rule moves and scales the Premium label, scales the sub-options and animates the inner indicator’s clip-path from a thin inset line to a full pill. The easing is a hand-written linear(). In this version the outer indicator becomes a light track under Premium, the chosen sub-tier is a solid black pill, and a bracket groups the pair, so the hierarchy reads clearly.

desc.zh: 未选中“免费”时它的透明度
desc.en: Free label opacity when not selected

adapt.zh: 任何“一级选项里藏着二级选项”的切换：月付 / 年付里再分档、视图切换。
adapt.en: Any toggle with nested options: billing period with tiers, view modes with variants.
